payload.final_answer: To identify the artiste, we should look for an English musician who debuted between 2001 and 2005, has released albums with Roman numerals in their titles between 2001 and 2007, and has expressed a desire to remain non-commercial in their music. A good starting point would be to search for English musicians who fit these criteria, particularly focusing on those known for their unique style and independent approach to music.
